_comment: Canonical geometry for the PLACEHOLDER Soundlog icon assets, read by scripts/generate-icons.mjs. All lengths are fractions of the tile edge. Derived from the Groove glyph's closed cut in a 24-unit box (ring r=7, stroke 3.2, spindle r=1.9) with the glyph box at 0.875 of the tile. Outermost ink sits at 0.2552 + 0.1167/2 = 0.3136 from centre, inside the 0.40 maskable safe radius. Editing this file and re-running the generator is the only sanctioned way to change the placeholders; final artwork replaces public/icons/ directly and makes both obsolete.
